name: fitralo-carriers
description: European directory of freight carriers: find carriers by route, equipment and certificates.

interface.longDescription:
Find road freight carriers in Europe for a route. Fitralo is a European directory of road freight carriers, and with this plugin ChatGPT searches it: describe a load in plain words (the route, the equipment, the certificates) and get the carriers that fit, best first.

The directory holds thousands of carriers in 32 countries, each checked monthly for signs of activity. Carriers for whom the route is their own line are marked as route specialists. A carrier's profile gives the countries and regions it serves, its services, equipment, certificates and fleet, and its phone number, e-mail address and website, so the user contacts the carrier directly.

For shippers, freight forwarders and logistics planners who need a carrier for a road transport in Europe.

With a linked Fitralo company account, ChatGPT also sends a transport request to the carriers the user chose, after the user confirmed it in the chat. Fitralo checks the request and translates it for each carrier, and the carriers answer the user by e-mail. Searching needs no account.

What it does not do: it books no transport, quotes no rates and tracks no shipments.

Tools:
- search_carriers (read-only): the carriers that fit a route and needs, with what the search understood, how many fit, how many are specialists, and a link to all results on fitralo.com
- get_carrier (read-only): a carrier's full profile with contact details
- send_request: sends a transport request in the name of the user's linked account to the carriers the user chose

Labels and links follow the user's language: Fitralo is available in 14 European languages.
defaultPrompt: Find carriers for chilled transport from Rotterdam to Milan
Which carriers do ADR transport from Rotterdam to Poland?
Who are the route specialists for groupage from Venlo to Lyon?

positive.prompt: Find carriers for chilled transport from Rotterdam to Milan
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_carriers and lists carriers that run Rotterdam to Milan with temperature-controlled transport, best first, with how many fit and a link to each Fitralo profile.

positive.description: Only the specialists of a route
positive.prompt: Which carriers do ADR transport from Rotterdam to Poland? Only route specialists.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_carriers with specialists_only and lists only carriers marked as specialists on this route that carry dangerous goods (ADR).

positive.description: Contact details of a carrier found
positive.prompt: Find a groupage carrier from Venlo to Lyon and give me its phone number and website
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the route, then calls get_carrier for a carrier found and gives its phone number, website and Fitralo profile link.

positive.prompt: Ik zoek een vervoerder voor groupage van Duitsland naar Italië met laadklep
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_carriers with language nl and answers in Dutch with carriers for groupage from Germany to Italy with a tail lift.

positive.description: A request to the carriers found
positive.prompt: Find two carriers for 12 pallets from Utrecht to Cologne next Tuesday and ask them for a quote
positive.expected_behavior: With the Fitralo account linked (the login for reviewers): searches the route, shows the carriers and the request and asks the user to confirm, and for a contact name when the account has none; after the confirmation calls send_request and gives the carriers it went to and the link to the request. With the login for reviewers nothing reaches a carrier.

negative.description: Fitralo has no prices: no price is presented as coming from Fitralo; at most it offers to find carriers to ask for a quote.
negative.prompt: What does it cost to ship 18 pallets from Venlo to Rome?

negative.description: Fitralo books no transport: nothing is booked and no request is sent unasked; at most it offers carriers to contact or to ask for a quote.
negative.prompt: Book a truck for tomorrow from Rotterdam to Milan

negative.description: Fitralo tracks no shipments: no tool is called.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.0: search carriers and open their profiles without an account; with a linked Fitralo account, send a transport request to the carriers chosen.
